author: Teri Patton Rich
message: I was researching for something to buy my sister-in-law who is going through a series of chemo when I found your site online. I felt so bad for her and what she was going through and I purchased the women’s chemo care package for her. I was impressed at how quickly it shipped to her. My brother said it was perfect. She has loved every item in the box. He said "whoever picked the contents, they know chemo…the lozenges, peanut butter crackers & everything else has been perfect for her nausea”. He said some of her church ladies had sweetly been bringing by flowers, but this was so much more helpful and really brought her spirits up. You have a great thing going here and I would recommend them to anyone having to go through this hard time in their lives.
replyMessage: Thank you so much for your kind words. It means the world to hear that the care package brought your sister-in-law comfort and lifted her spirits during such a difficult time. Please tell your brother his comment "whoever picked the contents, they know chemo" is one of the sweetest compliments we could receive. Wishing your sister-in-law strength and brighter days ahead, and thank you for trusting us to be a small part of her journey.

author: Tina DeM
message: Sent to a family member who was so appreciative of the goodies she could take to chemo the next day. The photos are from her. It’s a well made and thoughtful gift for anyone fighting cancer and I would highly recommend it. The owner has reached out personally both times I've placed orders and is truly special. Thank you!
replyMessage: It warms our heart to hear that your family member got their cancer care package just in time for their treatment! We loved the pictures thank you for sharing. Wishing your family member and you all many blessings.

author: Alissa Schneider

The order was shipped and delivered so fast, and when I made a mistake with the delivery address, the company quickly fixed it for me.

author: Deborah Russell
message: I sent one of the women's chemo baskets to my friend and she was so grateful. It was extremely heartwarming to give such a well-received gift. I really didn't want to give some overpriced food basket with stale cookies when food delivery services are everywhere. This was just perfect.
replyMessage: Thank you so much for your kind words. It means the world to us to know your gift brought comfort and was so warmly received during such a difficult time. We’re honored to help you support your friend in a meaningful way.

author: Isabelle D.

author: Tony

Knowing the package made this part of the journey a little easier means the world to us. Thank you for trusting us with such an important gift. Blessings.

She made a difficult process a little easier with her compassion and knowledge of helpful products. Ordering was easy and I was notified of tracking and delivery. I highly recommend Rock the Treatment if you find yourself in need of a gift for someone battling cancer.
replyMessage: Marilynne, thank you so much for taking the time to write such a lovely review. We are so pleased that your friends son found comfort and joy in the basket. We wish him and his family many blessings!

author: Kimberly Nettles

We're deeply moved to know the gift box brought her comfort and light during such a difficult time—that’s exactly why Rock the Treatment exists. It means the world to us that you took the time to share your experience, and we’re truly grateful for your support and kindness. Please know we’re sending continued strength and love to both of you. 💜

author: Larry Isaacs

author: Georgia Grasser
message: This was a wonderful thoughtful gift to give to someone going through chemotherapy! I sent this to my sister in law, she was very happy to receive this caring gift. I really loved it because you feel helpless and really want to let them know that you care and are thinking about them. There are many useful items that they will need! Also I like the idea that this company gives back!I would definitely order again!Thank you!
replyMessage: Georgia, thank you so much for the kind words. We are so happy to hear that your sister I. Law loved receiving your gift and that sending it gave you some peace knowing your were helping her. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to share. Blessings.

author: John Murphy
message: The following is the thank you text after our friend received her large Rock The Treatment care package:"I can't believe yall sent this to me. I'm crying right now. You are the most thoughtful beautiful person EVER!...thank you all from the bottom of our hearts. Everything in this beautiful gift box ticks all the boxes of what I'm going through and need help with!! Especially the word puzzles and coloring book. I have chemo brain. I'm not making sense at all...Everything in the box is so awesome! Thank you so much. I love you."I think that says it all.
replyMessage: John, That message brought tears to our eyes. It warms our heart to know that the Chemo Care Package you sent your dear friend was so impactful. We deeply appreciate you taking the time to share such lovely feedback. Blessings.

author: Sherry Kalonich
message: With my sister in laws first treatment approaching wanted to send her something! I found perfect gift an best company to work with! Gift is appropriate an filled with items she can use right away an she loved the box! I found the company to be genuine..fast service an delivery successful! Thank you all for what your doing!
replyMessage: Aw Sherry you are so kind. Thank you so much for your kind words and for taking the time to share them publicly. We pray for a day where we never have the need to send another basket like this. But until then we will be here doing what we can to help cancer warriors and the friends/family that support them. Blessings.

author: Laura Smith
message: I ordered the Radiation Therapy gift basket from Rock the Treatment for a friend who was recently diagnosed with a cancer that requires she undergo surgery followed by radiation. I really had no idea what sort of things were good for someone going through radiation therapy and it seemed a lot of baskets I'd seen elsewhere were more focused on chemo. It was nice to have this option.The ordering experience was super simple, effective and quick. The order shipped the same day and was received within 2 days. Not only that, but in addition to the standard "your package has shipped" email that you get pretty much anytime you order something online, Ms. Berk sent a separate email to let me know that the package had shipped, to let me know that her thoughts and prayers were with my friend (and she addressed her by name - I'm intentionally keeping her name out for her privacy). I thought it was a really nice added touch, while I'm sure it didn't take long, it was that added personal touch which meant a lot and made me glad I'd ordered from Rock the Treatment.My friend received her package and send it was wonderful - even though she doesn't start Radiation until later this week.I will admit, I priced some of the items individually prior to ordering to see if the gift basket was overpriced or reasonable and I will say it is very reasonably priced. If you want to send something to a friend or loved one going through cancer treatment, I highly recommend Rock the Treatment!
replyMessage: Laura, thank you so much for taking the time to share your lovely feedback. Battling cancer is very personal to the patients and their family and friends. We do our best to keep that in mind each step of the process. We hope your gift brings your friend a lot of comfort during treatment. Many blessings.

author: Kasenia Colombo
message: My sister and I got a medium box for my dad for his birthday as he's going through treatment and he LOVED it! Also, Stacy was very helpful and even delayed my shipment to make sure it didn't get to my dad's too early as I wasn't sure how fast it was going to ship when I ordered it. Thanks Stacy!
replyMessage: Kasenia, we are so happy that your dad found the gift helpful and that it brightened his day. Glad he got his birthday present at the perfect time! Many blessings 💜.

author: Holly Stettner
message: I wanted to order a medium Rock the Treatment box for a friends 17 year old daughter diagnosed almost overnight with stage 4 cancer. She was in between the adult box and the kid box. The box arrived a couple of days later and the young lady LOVED it! She said many of the items are helping her with the initial hardcore chemo schedule she's had to endure the past 18 days in the hospital. Thank you!
replyMessage: Holly, it was such a pleasure working with you. We were happy to help any way we could. We are praying that your gift brought some comfort and smiles during such a difficult time. Wishing many prayers and blessings.

author: Jill P
message: I don't often write reviews but in this case I felt it was necessary. I placed an order for someone who needed I smile. I found this company because I was googling gifts for people with cancer. I placed my order and immediately received a response saying that my order was placed and it would be delivered in the next couple of days. I was so surprised at the quick response and it wasn't one of those automated emails that my order has been placed, a person actually sent the email. A couple of weeks later I saw the person that the gift was sent to, I had never heard from her. I asked her if she received the gift and she said yes but she didn't know who it was from because there was no note. She gushed over how much she loved the ROCK THE TREATMENT box. I don't know if she just didn't see the note or if it wasn't there. So now this is two months later and I sent an email to the company explaining what the recipient told me. Again, immediately I received a response. Stacey told me how sorry she was and how thankful she was that I was telling her about this because she always wants the best for the recipients and the purchaser. She offered to send something to the recipient, the original note and an apology. So like I said I don't often write reviews but when you find a company and people who are so attentive and personable and care so much about their product a review is absolutely necessary. So my recommendation is that if you are looking to cheer up someone with cancer you can't find a better company than ROCK THE TREATMENT!!!!!
replyMessage: Jill, we so appreciate you taking the time to write such a thoughtful review. We do our very best to get everything perfect 100% of the time. Unfortunately, we know a mistake or two is inevitable. To us, the measure of a company is not in the mistake but how the mistake is handled. Your patience, understanding and kindness despite the fact all was not perfect I’d deeply appreciated. Many blessings.

replyMessage: Jamilah, ❤️ thank you so much for sharing. It truly warms our heart to hear your gift made your nieces day a bit more joyful. Blessings

author: Deborah Sturgill
message: I can't even begin to describe what a blessing this company is for those wanting to help friends and family going through chemo. Both families were so appreciative, and I had a company pick gifts that were custom made for chemo patients. I am so impressed and grateful. If you know of anyone that is going through chemo, I highly recommend that you order from a company that cares, Rock the Treatment. Thank you. Deborah Bronnes Sturgill

replyMessage: Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We are thrilled that your friend found our basket Useful we hope it helps her ROCK the TREATMENT!

author: Christine Delmas
message: I have never reviewed anything before but I feel compelled to give this company more than 5 stars. I would give them 10 if that was possible. First of all, I ordered the basket on a Sunday night expecting it would take at least a week and by Monday afternoon it had already reached the local post office - amazingly fast!Unfortunately, in our circumstances we got the unexpected and unthinkable news that the person we were sending this to could no longer receive chemo and would be going to hospice immediately. As if that was not enough, the horrible thought that this basket would arrive as soon as they got this news was terrifying. I immediately called the company and although the basket was already shipped, the owner went above and beyond to call the postmaster and intercept the package so we would not be adding more heartache to an already heartbroken family. She took care to call me right away and when I told her to keep the money for her troubles she insisted on refunding our money. A true class act who truly cares about her customers. On a really sad day she proved that they're still nice people in the world. Can't thank her enough.
replyMessage: Christine, we were happy to help anyway we could. Our thoughts and prayers are with your dear friend and his family. Thank you so much for taking the time to share your thoughts and kind words. Many blessings.

author: RJP
message: Oh my goodness! Words cannot express how grateful I am to have found this company and this particular basket! My sister-in-law, who has Neuromyelitis Optica Spectrum Disorder (NMOSD) and has to undergo chemotherapy treatments regularly, was obsessed over THE BOX it all came in (rainbow stripes)! She absolutely loved it!!! She kept saying "No way!" :-) Then, when she opened it all and saw how many wonderful, usable items were in there (she has MANY allergies and cannot use or eat most things), she was absolutely floored! Because of the ingredient lists being very simple and/or organic, she was able to use almost ALL of the items. The few others she simply shared with her neighbors who help her. It was a win-win! She was obsessed with the neck pillow and said it smelled AMAZING! That is really saying something, because she is one who cannot have flowers or scented things around her because of her allergies. Whatever was in that pillow definitely agreed with her system. She brought many of the items to the hospital with her for use during and immediately after her treatment (neck pillow, queasy drops, peppermint tea, etc.). She doesn't usually drink tea because of "other" ingredients, but said this tea is a no brainer, because it is pure peppermint, which was wonderful! She is also not usually into adult coloring books, but said this one is so cute that she is keeping it, saying the pictures are adorable and made her smile. She said that there were so many things in there that she would be able to use them for future treatment days also! WHAT A GREAT VALUE THIS BOX IS!!! Thank you, Rock The Treatment, for the wonderful things you are doing for people going through chemotherapy! I hope I never have to purchase another box like this, but if I do, I will definitely come back to your website first! God bless you all and all of your customers. <3
replyMessage: Rebecca, thank you so much for your beautiful review. We really appreciate you taking the time. We are so thrilled to hear that your sister-in-law enjoyed receiving your gift and it sounds like you brought her much happiness, joy and comfort. We work very hard curating the products that we use. So heartwarming to know that we did it right. Many blessings to you all.
